gh_e31e0f0f47c698e1c0d5a6d9.title: Fellowlane (recruitment agency) - Cloud Engineer Microsoft 365/Azure - Aalsmeer, Netherlands - 3,750-4,500 EUR/Month
gh_e31e0f0f47c698e1c0d5a6d9.description:
**Language requirement: Dutch proficiency is mandatory. Beheersing van het Nederlands is verplicht.**

## What You Will Get

### Salary and hours
- EUR 3,750–4,500 gross/month, depending on knowledge and experience.
- 32–40 hours per week.

### Benefits
- Freedom and technical responsibility in a small, informal team.
- Training and certification opportunities.
- Pension scheme, modern office in Aalsmeer and team activities.
- A mix of infrastructure management, projects and customer advice.

### Location
Aalsmeer, Netherlands, with customers in the surrounding region. Work is performed remotely on customer environments and on-site at customers. This is not advertised as a worldwide remote or fully work-from-home role.

## What You Will Do
- Manage and improve Microsoft 365, Azure and Windows Server environments.
- Work with Active Directory, Exchange, Hyper-V, firewalls, switches, backups and monitoring.
- Resolve complex second- and third-line technical issues.
- Deliver cloud migrations and other technical projects.
- Advise customers and support colleagues with complex technical questions.
- Improve security, automation, standardisation and technical documentation.

## Relevant Experience
This role is aimed at an experienced IT professional ready to combine Microsoft cloud and infrastructure operations with migrations, projects and customer advice. Relevant technologies include Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange and Hyper-V.

## About the company and recruiter
Fellowlane is a recruitment agency recruiting for an IT service provider in Aalsmeer. This is a client vacancy, not an internal Fellowlane role. The client supports regional organisations with cloud, infrastructure, workplaces, networking and security.

## How to Apply
[Full vacancy and application form (Dutch)](https://fellowlane.com/vacature/recruitee-cloud-engineer/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=techmasters#formulier)

Questions: [info@fellowlane.com](mailto:info@fellowlane.com), +31 297 30 81 51.
Please apply through the website and do not post your CV or personal details in this public issue.

gh_e3cea4edfbc7f630c99d150f.title: 徵才【日本大阪】NodeJS Backend Developer (年薪100~200萬台幣) #公司可提供簽證 #擴大招募!
gh_e3cea4edfbc7f630c99d150f.description:
📍其他資訊: 自2024/5月以來團隊已成長到8人，2025預計再加10人加入團隊!
📍類型: 博奕遊戲 
📍薪資: 年薪100~200萬台幣
📍外派流程:
-外派前2-3個月會先在台灣辦公室上班，等工作簽證下來後再前往日本
-外派到日本後的第1-2個月先住宿舍，之後會給房屋津貼自行找住宿地點唷
💫優先歡迎已經具備簽證的人選! 

Backend Developer /後端工程師
✍️相關經驗2年以上
1. 開發遊戲伺服器新功能。 
2. 與組員合作討論，分析需求定義並實作。 
3. 跟 Designer, PM, QA, Devops, Backend, Frontend, APP 合作完成「需求-設計-開發-測試-上線」的流程。 
4. 協助不同專案的系統開發、後端程式撰寫及維護，同時適時進行跨專案的支援。 
5. 網站的後端及相關 API 開發與串接並確保程式品質。 

【期待你的技術職能】 
1. 熟悉資料庫相關操作(Transaction)與建置(Schema)。 
2. 了解程式相關資安維護。 
3. 有專案設計、規畫、開發相關工作經驗者佳。 
4. 資訊工程或相關科、系(所)畢業佳，具備實際開發經驗則不限。
5. 程式語言需求(二擇一) : (1)Golang (2)NodeJS 
6. 資料庫需求(二擇一) : (1) Oracle (2) MySQL 

【如果有以下的經驗或特質，那就太加分】 
1. Docker 2. K8S 3. 邏輯調理能力佳

歡迎將履歷寄 至📩 joanne@recruitexpress.com.tw
來信告知應徵大阪工作
也可以直接加Joanne Line 好友討論唷! (ID a19901204)
